note: NightMail end-to-end mail (nightmail:e2e v1). Generated by packages/core-ts (npm run vectors); the specification is in README.md §4. Lowercase hex without 0x. The Rust core must reproduce payload, signature and envelope of every `valid` entry, open and verify them, return senderVerified = false for `unverified` and the stored senderVerified for `mixedOrderKey`, reject `openFailures` and `openFailureOversized`, and refuse to build `encodeFailures`.
